# `prefer-testing-expect-equal-strings`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports byte-string equality assertions that use a generic boolean or equality
check.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`expectEqualStrings` presents readable string differences instead of only
reporting a failed boolean condition.

## When it fires

It applies when both operands are proven string or byte-slice values in a
supported test assertion shape.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

test "greeting" {
    const greeting: []const u8 = "hello";
    try std.testing.expect(std.mem.eql(u8, greeting, "hello"));
}
```
